To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the development of human-centered software has to start with the identification of relevant stakeholders and their needs.

Continuous Requirements Engineering should cover the design time, runtime, and maintenance aspects, that it is important to integrate aspects of usability and UX in the development process, that Continuous Human-Centered Requirements Engineering is an important aspect, and that Continuous Human-Centerd Development has to be integrated into the software development process.
Continuous Human-Centered Agile development is a promising approach that needs to be investigated further.
In summary, our research is concerned with
integrating aspects of usability into the development process and the development of methods for this integration.
the development of a process model for a Human-Centered, Continuous Requirements Engineering and Software Development Process.
the question how the integration of HCD into the requirements engineering process can be achieved in a systematic and efficient way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are many aspects of HCD which are not yet sufficiently covered in current requirements engineering approaches.
the integration of HCD into a continuous development process is a challenge.
Continuous Human-Centered Requirements Engineering and Continuous Human-Centered Software Development are important and necessary, but that the details of such processes have to be worked out.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Continuous Requirements Engineering in a Human-Centered context is a very promising approach for future software development.
we have provided a framework for integrating Human-Centered Development and Continuous Requirements Engineering.
Continuous Requirements Engineering is an important aspect of Human-Centered Agile Processes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Continuous Requirements Engineering and HCD are closely related and that both have to be considered when developing a new software product or system.
the integration of HCD into the requirements engineering process and the development process has to be continuous.
Continuous Requirements Engineering and Continuous Human-Centered development are not only compatible, but that they complement each other.
